analysis:
Speaking at the National Education Day function on 11 November 2009, HRD Minister Kapil Sibal said the Right to Education Act would give an estimated 160 million children, described as 'presently out of school', access to quality education.

The Ministry of Human Resource Development's own PIB releases from 2009 cite an independent SRI-IMRB sample survey that counted about 80 lakh (8 million) out-of-school children in the 6-14 age group, equal to 4.22%.

The 160 million figure is of the order of the total child population in the relevant age band rather than the number out of school, so the claim overstates the out-of-school count by roughly an order of magnitude of about twenty.
